research_notes: World Medical Mission is the medical arm of Samaritan's Purse, operating as a program/department rather than independent entity. Staff identified are Samaritan's Purse employees. Significant structural limitation: Development and organizational advancement functions are not publicly visible at the World Medical Mission level—they appear to be centralized at the Samaritan's Purse organizational level. Post-Residency Program places individual physicians who raise personal support, but program coordinators/directors are not publicly named. Technical Support Department is well-documented with 22 staff members, but these are operational roles rather than development/advancement positions of interest to donor research.
